Package index

Logos, Wordmarks & Headshots

ggplot2 geoms and ggproto objects for rendering team logos, wordmarks and player headshots on plots. Every geom takes a sport argument.

geom_sdv_logos() GeomSDVlogo
ggplot2 Layer for Visualizing Sports Team Logos
geom_sdv_wordmarks() GeomSDVwordmark
ggplot2 Layer for Visualizing Sports Team Wordmarks
geom_sdv_headshots() GeomSDVheadshot
ggplot2 Layer for Visualizing Player Headshots

Theme Elements

Image-based ggplot2 theme elements for axis text — replace tick labels with team logos, wordmarks or player headshots.

element_sdv_logo() element_sdv_wordmark() element_sdv_headshot() element_sdv_raster()
Theme Elements for Image Grobs

Scales & Axes

Team color / fill scales, logo and headshot axis scales, and the matching theme helpers.

scale_color_sdv() scale_colour_sdv() scale_fill_sdv()
Scales for Sports Team Colors
scale_x_sdv() scale_y_sdv() scale_x_sdv_headshots() scale_y_sdv_headshots()
Axis Scales for Sports Team Logos
theme_x_sdv() theme_y_sdv()
Theme Helpers for SDV Axis Labels
